messages:
lina_support: Customer (acme-payments) reporting sudden 403s from the Generate API after a recent invoice change. They say tokens and signatures unchanged. Sending logs.

lina_support: curl they used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-mini","input":"hello"}'
```

lina_support: Response body:
```json
{"error":{"message":"Unauthorized","type":"invalid_request_error","code":"403"}}
```

headers: `x-request-id: rq_01F...`, `x-entitlement: blocked`, `x-entitlement-reason: billing_tier`

devin_eng: can you paste the full raw headers (esp any `x-entitlement-*` and `www-authenticate`)? 403 with "Unauthorized" is super confusing for customers.

lina_support: pasted above, full header dump attached in thread (redacted API key). Looks like `x-entitlement-reason: billing_tier_exceeded` and `x-entitlement-plan: starter`. No `www-authenticate` header.

sophie_billing: tagging from billing — did the customer's plan drop or invoice fail?

sophie_billing: i see an automatic downgrade on 2026-12-27 due to failed CC charge. Their plan was Starter -> Free trial expired -> auto-downgrade to Free. They still have a valid API key though.

matt_platform: this is the classic confusion: entitlement gating currently returns 403 with generic auth messaging. That looks like a bad auth token instead of a plan/feature block. We should make the error explicit.

devin_eng: repro steps for platform: try a trial account switched to free and hit generate, we should see `403` plus `x-entitlement-reason`. I can repro locally.

devin_eng: repro snippet (internal):
```bash
HTTP/1.1 POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-test-xxx

-> 403
Headers:
  x-entitlement: blocked
  x-entitlement-reason: billing_tier_exceeded
Body:
{"error":{"message":"Unauthorized","type":"invalid_request_error","code":"403"}}
```

matt_platform: two quick asks: 1) short-term — change error body to be clearer (code: "entitlement_required", message: "Insufficient plan: enable X or upgrade to Y"); 2) medium-term — return 402 or 403 with distinct error code and update SDKs/docs.

entitlement-bot: Created ticket ET-4827 for "Clarify entitlement 403 responses" and linked to alert channel.

sophie_billing: for customer resolution: we can re-enable a grace period manually if they have a pursuable invoice. Should i create a one-off grace flag?

lina_support: customer asked for immediate unblock, says they have a purchase order in flight. Requesting 24h grace.

matt_platform: grant temporary soft-entitlement for `org:acme-payments` for 24h with reason "support_grace_PO". I'll run the command now.

matt_platform: command used:
```bash
redwoodctl entitlements grant --org acme-payments --feature generate --duration 24h --reason support_grace_PO
# output: OK ent-grant-9001
```

devin_eng: pushed a small backend patch to change the body for entitlement failures (staging only) — PR: github.com/redwood/entitlement/pull/312. It sets `error.code` to `entitlement_required` and adds `entitlement_hint`.

lina_support: customer confirmed 200 within 10m after the grant. They still confused about why it looked like an auth error.

matt_platform: followups:
- engineering: prioritize standardized `www-authenticate` or `x-error-code` for entitlement vs auth.
- docs: add a troubleshooting section mapping 403 -> "billing/entitlement" when `x-entitlement` header present.
- support: update playbook with `redwoodctl entitlements grant` step.

sophie_billing: also noted: we should not use the 401/403 messages that mention token expiry for entitlement failures. that'll reduce tickets.

devin_eng: timeline: quickfix to error body in 48h, full spec for error codes + header docs in 2 weeks, SDKs to expose new codes in 4 weeks.

lina_support: will close customer ticket now and send PO escalation to billing. Adding recommended KB snippet to the case: "If you receive a 403 with `x-entitlement: blocked` — check billing/policy and contact support for a 24h grace." ✅

matt_platform: one more thought — telemetry: emit metric `entitlement.blocked.vs.auth` with `reason=billing_tier` so we can measure frequency and reduce confusion.

devin_eng: ack, i'll add metric and a dashboard cell for it.

lina_support: thanks all — marking this thread resolved for internal followups.

#attachments: invoice-snapshot.png, header-dump.txt, PR link: github.com/redwood/entitlement/pull/312
